name: pixelSplat
aliases: DepthSplat — A method connecting Gaussian splatting and depth estimation by leveraging pre-trained monocular depth features to augment multi-view feature matching, enabling robust multi-view depth prediction and feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting reconstruction.
definition: A feed-forward model that learns to reconstruct 3D radiance fields parameterized by 3D Gaussian primitives from pairs of images, enabling real-time and memory-efficient rendering and fast 3D reconstruction at inference time.
